slide01.title: 21 years of a festival that shapes generations
slide01.subtitle: national festival of young theatre

slide02.p1: Ideo Ideis is a national young-theatre festival held every year in Alexandria.
slide02.p2: For one week, teenagers from across the country take part in workshops, performances and conversations alongside artists and mentors.
slide02.p3: Throughout the year, Ideo Ideis continues through Ideo Talks, podcasts, workshops and initiatives dedicated to young people.
facts: a project with cultural impact and national visibility

slide03.lead: Every summer, Alexandria <hl>breathes to a different rhythm</hl>.
slide03.p1: In the evening, people fill the square for the film screenings. They go to the theatre performances. They meet and stay for the conversations afterwards.
slide03.p2: The festival brings together teenagers, artists and the local community. For a few days, the city gathers around culture.

program.opportunity: branding in educational spaces · custom kits

program.activity: murals and activations across the city

slide04.p1: In 2026, the square becomes the heart of the festival.
slide04.p2: An open place for exchanging ideas, information and cultural experiences.
slide04.p3: A shared space for teenagers, children and adults, around performances, screenings and conversations. The festival becomes the city and invites the community to take part.
slide04.calloutText: +20% media reach vs. 2025 · the largest open-air community hub south of Bucharest
rows: more <hl>integration</hl> of the Alexandria community into the festival's activities
a better <hl>experience</hl> for participants and audience: a healthy pace, broad access
greater national <hl>visibility</hl> and collaborations with clear impact

slide05.lead: 6,000+ teenagers trained, 200,000 spectators, 16M+ media reach — a project with cultural impact and national visibility.

stats.label: teenagers have grown up with Ideo Ideis

slide06.title: people
slide06.p1: artists, mentors, trainers and guests who work directly with the teenagers - just a few of the people who have come through Ideo Ideis.

slide07.title: what <hl>teenagers</hl> learn
slide07.p1: At IDEO, theatre is the tool for clarifying values, responsibility, expression and ownership.
slide07.p2: Teenagers create, work in teams, discuss current topics and step on stage.
slide07.p3: It is one of the few festivals in Romania built especially for this age.

modules.label: empathy & communication
modules.subtitle: through practice, not theory
modules.text: Theatre and new-media workshops put teenagers in real situations: to listen, to collaborate, to negotiate. Skills that no school subject teaches systematically.

modules.label: critical thinking
modules.subtitle: real questions, real contexts
modules.text: Performances and dialogues with relevant artists challenge teenagers to analyse, to argue and to form their own opinions, rather than reproduce answers.

modules.label: responsibility & involvement
modules.subtitle: characters shaped, not rewarded
modules.text: Through the framework it offers, Ideo Ideis shapes character: it helps young people clarify their values, understand what it means to be part of a community and take on their role in it.

modules.label: community integration
modules.subtitle: the city as a stage
modules.text: In 2026 we are expanding the programme to include the entire Alexandria community, families, teachers, the wider public, not just the selected participants.

slide08.p1: The teenagers who come to Ideo Ideis carry the festival further, into their own towns.
slide08.p2: The values and experiences lived in Alexandria turn into initiatives, theatre groups, projects and dialogue in their communities.
slide08.p3: Ideo Ideis starts in Alexandria and continues across the whole country.

slide09.title: Ideo Ideis <hl>continues</hl>
slide09.p1: The dialogue that began in Alexandria goes further through podcasts, Ideo Talks and workshops held throughout the year.
slide09.p2: The community stays active. The process of growth continues.
slide09.p3: Ideo Ideis is an ecosystem, not just an event.

slide10.heading: Supporting Ideo Ideis means supporting the development of a generation and the cultural vitality of a community.
slide10.p1: Partner brands become part of this process by backing a national programme with credibility and associating themselves with an active, educated and engaged generation.
slide10.footer: Partnership becomes a contribution to a living process, not just brand presence.

slide11.title: we can create <hl>together</hl>
slide11.p1: Every collaboration can be built around our shared values.
items: initiatives dedicated to the local community
slide11.footer: Ideo Ideis is looking for partners who believe in growth, dialogue and cultural responsibility.

slide12.title: The 21st edition starts now.
slide12.p1: We invite you to become part of a project that builds, year after year, a generation that is more attentive, more creative and more connected to the world.
slide12.p2: see you this summer in Alexandria.
slide12.p3: Throughout the year we meet in Bucharest or in any of the cities where we run events.
